page_subtitle: Terms, Privacy, Refund and Shipping policies — pre-written for an Algerian COD store, and yours to edit.
disclaimer: These pages are a starting point written for Algerian cash-on-delivery stores. Review them for your business, and consult a lawyer for your specific situation.
